title: Sectionwise abelian-object functors are bijective on objects
statement: Let C be a category with Grothendieck topology J. Work in any universe of sets at least as large as the object and morphism universes of C. Let F be a functor from abelian sheaves to internal commutative group objects of sheaves of sets. Suppose hF identifies its underlying-set composite with sectionwise forgetting, as an equality of functors. Suppose the transported internal multiplication, unit and inverse of F(A), on each section, agree with the addition, zero and negation of A. Then F.obj is bijective.

proof.text: Apply the injectivity and surjectivity halves and package them as Function.Bijective.

proof_origin.note: Decomposed into strict injectivity and surjectivity obligations, combined by a complete Lean proof.
